title: docs: point install options at published artifacts, add HACS option
body:
Add-on notes it uses the prebuilt GHCR image, new HACS integration option
(links to the not-yet-written HACS integration section), Docker/compose use
ghcr.io/odtgit/evmqtt:latest instead of a local build, pip installs from
PyPI with source/editable moved to Development, and systemd covers a venv
or pipx global install since DynamicUser has no home directory for a
per-user install to land in.

Also fixes the device-cgroup rule to 'c 13:* rmw' (needs mknod for
hotplug) and drops the :ro on the /dev/input bind mount, in README and
compose.yaml.
commits: docs: point install options at published artifacts, add HACS option
author: historical
note: real: /dev/input bind mount made read-write and cgroup rule widened to c 13:* rmw; later reverted in b2e5648
